selections.rationale:
**Change class:** reference-fix.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Accept Mapping records instead of dict-only. Preserve matrix validation, stride partition by one-based position and independent per-target pixel copies.

**Decisive test requirements:** One UserDict record with pixels [[0]], sector s, distance d must populate both training targets; include MappingProxy control, two/three record stride boundaries, independent cross-target mutation, malformed matrix and empty input.

**Contract decisions / limits:** No new numeric policy: pixels are explicitly bounded 0..255. Preserve sequence matrix contents, not concrete wrapper types; fresh tests must not demand list output when a valid matrix sequence is retained.

**Change class:** reference-fix.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Accept standard Mapping items and snapshot their outer contents before copying/resolution; do not merely allow Mapping then deepcopy a noncopyable outer proxy. Preserve cross-list IDs, votes ordering, pagination and independent resolved copies.

**Decisive test requirements:** UserDict and MappingProxy items with id a/title A/votes1 must appear on the item page and in repeated collection resolutions. Mutating one returned resolved item must not affect another or stored input. Include duplicate/unknown IDs, negative votes and beyond-page totals.

**Contract decisions / limits:** Collection shape is stated structurally without a concrete class: keep ordinary dict controls and do not introduce a new dict-only policy. Sequence item_ids must remain repeatable; no requirement to accept one-shot generators as sequences. No numeric cap on integer votes.

**Change class:** reference-fix.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Normalize validated outer fields Mapping into a detached standard container before deep-copying; preserve read-only properties, complete field validation and consistency checks.

**Decisive test requirements:** MappingProxy reply fields followed by backing-map mutation must remain unchanged; MappingProxy job with mutable tags, UserDict controls, repeated property isolation and malformed fields exercise the repair.

**Contract decisions / limits:** Do not require a concrete copied Mapping class or arbitrary hostile/noncopyable descendants. Invalid-kind ValueError versus malformed field TypeError remains the stated distinction; no private-field layout test.

**Change class:** reference-fix.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Accept Mapping scoped_suffixes while retaining explicit list/dict/tuple requirements on other inputs. Preserve directory/global/scoped rule union, input order and separate deep copies across dry-run output lists.

**Decisive test requirements:** UserDict or MappingProxy {('src',):('.tmp',)} removes src/a.tmp. A dry-run candidate must appear independently in removed and remaining, with nested mutation controls; overlapping scopes and directory entries remain correctly treated.

**Contract decisions / limits:** No permission for filesystem access. Keep arbitrary ordinary deep-copy-supported metadata; do not add opaque-object cloning policy or widen entry dict contract.

**Change class:** reference-fix.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Accept Mapping labels and snapshot outer contents before deep-copying, so UserDict and MappingProxy labels work through SignalSpec and later catalog copies.

**Decisive test requirements:** Create SignalSpec with MappingProxy {'tags':['api']}, construct catalog, mutate backing tags and returned find/all objects, and require original values plus insertion order. Duplicate codes and iterator constructor semantics remain.

**Contract decisions / limits:** No concrete labels wrapper preservation requirement. No new restriction on mutable public SignalSpec attributes after construction; catalogue behavior remains repeated add and detached ownership.

**Change class:** reference-fix.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Separate file-path validation from entry-path validation so root '/' is a valid directory entry but never a document file. Preserve nearest profile-first search and separate anchor fallback.

**Decisive test requirements:** nearest_bundle('/a/doc','ember',{'/','/a','/a/ember.lock'}) returns '/a'. Include root marker, unrelated deeper descendants, profile marker above a nearer anchor and malformed normalized paths.

**Contract decisions / limits:** Entries carry no file/directory type metadata; do not invent such metadata or a physical-filesystem existence check. Root entry itself is not a marker.

**Change class:** reference-fix.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Allow every nonempty string composed of lowercase ASCII letters, digits and hyphens, without unstated hyphen placement restrictions. Preserve edits, normalization, routes and deep ownership.

**Decisive test requirements:** Recipe slug a--b round-trips through constructor/detail/edit/resolve. Include leading/trailing hyphens and all-hyphen nonempty controls, invalid uppercase/underscore and failed-edit state preservation.

**Contract decisions / limits:** This is the stated character-set grammar, not a URL standard. Do not strip slugs, collapse hyphens, require a letter, or change title/tag normalization.

**Change class:** contract-clarification.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Explicitly interpret placeholder identifier with Python str.isidentifier, including Unicode identifiers, and use the same parsing in register and resolve. Preserve segment specificity and registration-order ties.

**Decisive test requirements:** Register /{é} to a string target and resolve /value to {'é':'value'}; include a Unicode wildcard name, duplicate-name rejection, literal over capture over wildcard and fresh parameter dictionaries.

**Contract decisions / limits:** Freeze identifier interpretation explicitly; no ASCII-only restriction. Preserve existing nonempty-string target API behavior in the derived contract if documenting it, rather than silently inventing alternate target types. No URL decoding/normalization.

**Change class:** contract-clarification.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Make assignment/header recognition explicit: a significant assignment such as value=items[0] is not a malformed header merely because it ends with ]. Preserve section uniqueness, full validation and replacement order.

**Decisive test requirements:** ['[main]','value=items[0]'] returns the exact bracketed value. Include values containing '=' and brackets, empty value, malformed actual header, duplicate sections and late invalid line.

**Contract decisions / limits:** Resolve only recognition ambiguity in derived prose: actual header syntax is the enclosing [name] form; assignment lines use first '=' and may contain brackets. Explicitly retain bracket-free header names if keeping the original [[a]] rejection. Do not leave a contradictory unrestricted header-name claim.

**Change class:** oracle-rebuild.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Remove test-specific colon-as-extra-comma accommodation; three comma fields with invalid enabled flag return InvalidEnabled. Rebuild contradictory original assertion.

**Decisive test requirements:** id,on:off,tag must yield InvalidEnabled; actual fourth comma yields WrongFieldCount. Preserve trimmed valid tags, order/duplicates, empty third field and invalid ID/tag controls.

**Contract decisions / limits:** Use existing enum variants, with field-count determined by comma splitting. Do not infer unspecified cross-error priority. Tests match variants/fields without adding derives.

**Change class:** oracle-rebuild.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Remove unstated at-least-one-alphanumeric requirement from suffix/host grammar; rebuild original dot-only rejection.

**Decisive test requirements:** Policy with suffix '.' and Reject must construct and reject host '.' by exact match. Hyphen-only and allowed mixed controls, suffix boundary, kind filter and first-match order remain.

**Contract decisions / limits:** Nonempty allowed-character domain is not DNS hostname validation. Preserve Policy::new associated API and only explicit Copy/equality traits for enums; no unpromised Rule/Policy derives.

**Change class:** oracle-rebuild.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Permit nonempty queries of different arity to fall back to model mean; retain equal observation arity and atomic updates. Rebuild original query-arity rejection assertions.

**Decisive test requirements:** Model outcomes 10 and 20 with two features; query [9] has no exact match and returns15. Mixed-arity nonempty query batch preserves order; empty query still errors and empty queries still require known model.

**Contract decisions / limits:** Freeze constructor locations explicitly (existing ObservationStore::new and free new wrapper) and only required public traits. i128 summation remains as specified; no float mean or new query arity constraint.

**Change class:** reference-fix.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Complete allocation validation before accumulating units or fees; then preserve stated arithmetic/credit/fee priority.

**Decisive test requirements:** Allocations [('a',MAX),('b',1),('',1)] must yield EmptyRecipient, not overflow. A late zero-unit variant yields ZeroAllocation; all-valid MAX+1 gives ArithmeticOverflow. Exact credit/fee funding succeeds.

**Contract decisions / limits:** No priority beyond stated class ordering is invented; preserve input-order allocation checks. Match errors without unpromised public derives.

**Change class:** reference-fix.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Make spreadsheet-label conversion accept zero-based usize::MAX without overflowing a temporary one-based value. Keep full label syntax validation before conversion and existing column semantics.

**Decisive test requirements:** Generate the short label for usize::MAX using an independent u128 oracle under pinned64-bit runtime; total_column on empty tables returns Ok(empty), and on a tiny table returns absent/zero. Next index overflows. Keep A/Z/AA and malformed labels.

**Contract decisions / limits:** No huge row allocation or new float finiteness policy. Preserve the existing numeric-cell sum semantics rather than claim exact real arithmetic for unrestricted f64 values.

**Change class:** oracle-rebuild.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Remove artificial rejection when checked destination balance equals u64::MAX; rebuild original test that calls exact maximum an overflow. Preserve conservation and individual/batch atomicity.

**Decisive test requirements:** Create supply MAX in rich, transfer1 to sender then1 back; require rich MAX, sender0 and unchanged total. Include full-supply transfer, batch rollback and ordinary invalid transfers.

**Contract decisions / limits:** Preserve and explicitly enumerate current public method signatures in derived prose if needed. No private balance injection: actual overflow is unreachable through conserved valid supply; do not fabricate an overflow execution case.

**Change class:** reference-fix.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Sort complete scope::tag strings rather than relying on component-map traversal. Preserve clone ownership, name grammar and transactional batches.

**Decisive test requirements:** Scopes a and a0 each with x must return ['a0::x','a::x']; combine prefix scopes, tags, failed enabled batch, disabled malformed batch and detached returned strings.

**Contract decisions / limits:** No new trait demands beyond cloneable registry. Error payload assertions use matching, not unpromised Eq/Debug.

**Change class:** contract-clarification.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Remove unstated alphanumeric/underscore-only name restriction while preserving delimiter-start recognition, whole-input validation and nonnested matching.

**Decisive test requirements:** [item-name]exact text[/item-name] requested as item-name must return exact text. Include malformed suffix after match, empty content, ordinary non-delimiter brackets and duplicates.

**Contract decisions / limits:** Explicitly freeze a delimiter name as text from an ASCII-letter opening start to the next closing bracket, without a hidden hyphen ban; closing delimiter must match. Specify Malformed precedence over Duplicate when both occur to fulfill complete malformed-input validation. Do not broadly accept nested delimiters or change ordinary-bracket recognition.

**Change class:** contract-clarification.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Check every root-to-leaf route's numeric validity, not only the winning subtree maximum. Preserve exact-tree structural validation and negative-route behavior.

**Decisive test requirements:** Edges [(0,1,-1),(1,2,MIN),(1,3,0)] must return None although the winning route is -1. Include positive overflowing nonwinner, valid negative tree, nonzero root and invalid disconnected/cyclic topology.

**Contract decisions / limits:** Freeze checked addition in root-to-leaf traversal order, rejecting any overflowing prefix on those routes. This resolves parent grouping ambiguity explicitly; use iterative traversal to avoid introducing recursive-depth dependence. No numeric cap or new error type.

**Change class:** reference-fix.

**Minimal coherent correction:** Defer CostOverflow disposition until a complete otherwise-valid tour is established; an overflowing dead-end prefix must not reject a graph with no complete tours. Preserve full validation before traversal and lexicographic oriented output.

**Decisive test requirements:** A-B MAX, B-C1 plus disconnected D-E1 gives Ok(empty), not CostOverflow. Connected A-B MAX/B-C1 gives CostOverflow. Also test an overflowing dead-end branch alongside a valid complete path, normal reverse tours and duplicate validation.

**Contract decisions / limits:** Track overflow state while continuing topology exploration or evaluate completed tours; do not prune away overflowed complete tours. Existing checked-u64 semantics and public traits remain, no arbitrary graph-size cap or alternative floating sum.

Substantive target: Immutable outcome/request boundaries, checked failure routing and exact uninterpreted destination.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Snapshot the outcome links map at construction and prevent mutation through getLinks (unmodifiable snapshot or fresh defensive copy); retain null map/null entries so malformed data is rejected by buildTransfer as PaymentException, not a new Map.copyOf constructor NPE. Mutate original payment entry after constructing outcome but before buildTransfer: original destination must be used. Attempt getter-map mutation and verify outcome stays unchanged, accepting either rejection or harmless copy mutation. Preserve null directive/method tests, no URI interpretation and current character whitespace semantics. No new constructor-validation rule.

Substantive target: Nested DTO mapping with no scalar normalization, full null validation, duplicate order and immutable email snapshot.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Validate email elements by iteration, not contains(null). Map valid List.of(a@b), List.of(), and duplicated immutable emails; preserve order/duplicates, nullable scalar strings and arbitrary age. Mutable list with a null element must still produce IllegalArgumentException. Verify caller mutation cannot change profile and returned list is unmodifiable. No new email syntax/age/name rules.

Substantive target: Ordered user callback pipeline, null-return failure, list snapshots and locale-independent case conversion.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Validate stages by iteration before copying, accepting List.of() and List.of(stage). Empty workflow returns original string; callbacks remain ordered, null-return rejection and later caller-list mutation isolation stay tested. Keep Locale.ROOT uppercase and existing TrimStage behavior; do not substitute a wider whitespace-strip contract. No new exception policy for arbitrary stage-thrown exceptions.

Substantive target: Full nested validation, enabled filtering, resource order, sorted duplicate-preserving recipes and deep unmodifiable outputs.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Replace contains(null) checks with element traversal for enabledModules and every recipe list. Test Set.of() and Set.of(m), List.of() and nonempty List.of recipes, including disabled recipe lists that must still validate. Retain malformed nested maps/lists rejection before filtering, resource iteration order, recipe module/string ordering, duplicates, client/server language and deep immutability. No new collection implementation or normalization restriction.

Substantive target: Deterministic dual-format serialization with key grammar, ordering, format-specific quoting and atomic errors.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Use JSON string encoding for JSON values/keys, keeping strconv.Quote semantics only for FormatLines. Tiny value containing U+0007 (bell), U+000B and NUL must round-trip through encoding/json; assert compact ordered object and final newline, without demanding one equivalent JSON escape spelling. Preserve exact Go-quoted lines, valid UTF-8 values, nil/empty maps and invalid-key/format empty-output errors. No contract expansion.

Substantive target: Thread-safe atomic ledger with coherent ordered snapshots, length/ASCII validation and no aliases.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Order by original keys, not rendered key=value strings; do not re-sort rendered entries. Exact witness keys A and A0 with values x,y requires [A=x,A0=y]. Original concurrent tests compare entire rendered strings and would incorrectly reject a key-sorted implementation for prefix keys; replace those assertions by parsing at first '=' and comparing keys only. Values may themselves contain '='. Preserve synchronized snapshot coherence, valid empty values and ASCII key rules. Bounded concurrent writes/reads/snapshots with per-writer keys and joined exact final state; clear only at controlled boundaries unless oracle accounts for it. No new scheduling assumptions or promised cross-call transaction.

Substantive target: Go AST parsing, structural type rendering, ambiguity suppression and destination declaration order.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Fold only ASCII A–Z in eligible field names, not Unicode letters elsewhere in an identifier. Destination Aİ and source Ai of identical type must not match; Aİ should still match itself. Include an ordinary ASCII case match and an ambiguity case so matching and suppression remain correct. Preserve parsing-only scope (not type checking), exact rendered types, embedded/unexported exclusion and multi-name order. No contract decision needed.

Substantive target: Immutable nested value/list ownership and polymorphic all-part/all-value eligibility.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Validate TemplateField values by iteration before defensive copy; List.of() must construct and canExpand(List.of(field)) must return true. Also valid nonempty immutable Value list, false-template/nonempty-expression rejection, custom Part/null-part false and caller-list mutations. Constructor prose promises rejection but does not name a subtype; do not turn original tests' IAE preference into a newly required subtype. No new rule for empty expression or aliasing immutable Value objects.

Substantive target: Scoped component lifecycle, uniqueness, sorted filtering and detached output.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Use a structural (scope,name) key consistently in Create/Get/Delete. Create scope a+NUL+b/name c and scope a/name b+NUL+c with different releases; both must exist, list only in their scopes, and delete independently. Keep Quota64, exact strings and empty-field rules. Do not prohibit NUL, trim names, add nil-receiver requirements or change list semantics.

Substantive target: Pattern parsing, placeholder uniqueness, first-match resolution, exact methods and fresh parameter maps.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Use a structural method/pattern identity. Routes (method GET+NUL+/x, pattern /y) and (method GET, pattern /x+NUL+/y) have the same old concatenation but are distinct valid pairs; construction and both exact resolutions must succeed. Retain true duplicate rejection, slash/placeholder grammar, first-registration priority and copied inputs. No nil-receiver guarantee or identifier restriction added.

Substantive target: Immutable open/close lifecycle, fresh state, deep list boundary and full-input visibility validation.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Validate every Boolean entry even after a false; [false,null] and [true,false,null] must throw IllegalArgumentException, while false-only returns false and empty returns true. Preserve card validation, unmodifiable snapshot and new close-state identity even when already closed. Original tests require different getCards list identities; immutable list sharing is not prohibited by no-mutable-alias wording, so avoid that extra identity requirement in new oracle. Do not change nonempty cards to nonblank.

Substantive target: Independent checked generator state, finite exhaustion and detached prefix collection.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Bound allocation by the finite output or grow incrementally. PowersOfThree(MaxInt) must return exactly41 values ending12157665459056928801 with tiny memory; never attempt MaxInt generator outputs. Retain multiple independent generators, permanent zero/false after exhaustion, positive prefixes and explicitly nonnil empty for nonpositive n. No unlimited-memory guarantee inferred.

Substantive target: Inventory CRUD, canonical textual identity, lexicographic ordering and nested slice ownership.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Validate canonical positive ASCII decimal ID text directly rather than parsing to machine int. Add/get/update/delete ID18446744073709551616; preserve full string and lexicographic order. Keep rejected signs/leading zero/zero/nondigits, no normalization, tag snapshots and explicit empty collection behavior. ID is text with no numeric upper bound; do not add one.

Substantive target: Whole-input validation before filters, timestamps, sorted cursor pagination and nested copies.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Compute page length bounded by remaining matches before adding to offset. One/two valid records, Cursor1 and PageSizeMaxInt must yield respectively empty/one-row success without overflow. Preserve native-int canonical cursor overflow rejection, full validation of excluded records, inclusive date filtering and copies. Do not strengthen RFC3339 beyond existing time.Parse behavior. Original tests demand nonnil empty rows although prompt only says empty input valid: new tests should assert content/length unless that representation is separately approved; no need to change reference's existing representation.

Substantive target: Algorithm trace lifecycle, termination pass and nested defensive snapshots.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Record the final no-swap pass even if the last possible comparison pass swapped. [1,2] must yield two [2,1] snapshots; already descending length2 yields one; empty/singleton yield none. Preserve descending numeric comparison without subtraction overflow, input copy and defensive arrays on every accessor plus unmodifiable pass list. For longer cases preserve existing shrinking left-to-right bubble schedule rather than introducing a new trace algorithm; require completion/no-swap evidence without unspecified alternative-schedule oracles.

Substantive target: Layout validation, consumed-capacity arithmetic, ordered sections and exact serialized totals.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Before adding each positive span and inter-segment gap, compare against remaining capacity; reject mathematical overcapacity even if int addition would wrap. CapacityMaxInt with spansMaxInt and1 must fail; spans1,1 with GapMaxInt fail; single spanMaxInt exact-fit succeeds and ignores unused gap. Preserve raw material/code interpolation (do not invent escaping), order, exact final newline and existing marks rules. No new overflow policy: overcapacity is already error.

Substantive target: Severity parsing plus full-list validation, stable threshold filtering and copy boundaries.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: After existing whitespace trimming, fold ASCII letters only. ParseSeverity(U+0130NFO) and FilterLogs with that minimum must return ErrInvalidLevel (nil filter result), while mixed ASCII INFO passes. Keep empty messages, duplicates, all-entry validation including excluded levels and nonnil empty outputs. Do not narrow whitespace trimming itself or alter severity ordering.

Substantive target: Optional-field updates, transaction atomicity, original-on-error semantics and pointer ownership.

Minimal correction / independent tests / explicit limits: Look up original value before rejecting an empty code, while still rejecting it and never changing table. A table with key empty-string mapped to a nonzero InventoryItem must return that original item plus error; nil/missing maps return zero. Retain full-patch validation, zero allowed cost, notes clearing, nonblank name/group and no retained patch pointers. No contract decision needed; input table has no valid-key-only precondition.

Validated credit transaction

- Proposed change class: `reference-fix`.
- Exact current hold: Matching first account masks malformed trailing hole, which bypasses whole-array validation.
- Narrow correction: Replace hole-skipping accounts.map validation with full indexed/value iteration before lookup or credit. Preserve numeric error classes, unique keys, safe balance arithmetic, copy every required field and preserve order.
- Decisive witness and required retained coverage: Two-element accounts array with a valid matching first record and a trailing hole; credit must throw TypeError without mutating the first record. Also test an unrelated malformed trailing dense record, missing-account snapshots and unsafe credit.
- Contract decisions / hard limits: Do not narrow integer/string ranges, add trim rules, or reject previously accepted required-field descriptors. The mutant should only skip a hole; other behavior must satisfy the specification.

Atomic schedule replacement and checked totals

- Proposed change class: `reference-fix`.
- Exact current hold: Sparse replacement schedule bypasses record validation.
- Narrow correction: Validate every input index in initialEntries and replace before committing a dense copied schedule. Preserve in-place upsert order, remove/clear, product and total safe-integer checks.
- Decisive witness and required retained coverage: Start with one entry, call replace(new Array(1)); require TypeError and unchanged list/total. Test valid-prefix/trailing-hole replacement, constructor hole rejection and ordinary valid replacement.
- Contract decisions / hard limits: No new entry-count limits; keep product/sum error behavior, raw nonempty IDs and detached arguments. Do not validate only an early matching ID.

Defect-state command handler

- Proposed change class: `reference-fix`.
- Exact current hold: Sparse malformed ledger returns success instead of invalid-state response.
- Narrow correction: Replace every-based sparse state acceptance with complete logical-element validation before dispatch. Retain malformed-state empty reset versus valid-state unchanged snapshots, status codes and independent body/state copies.
- Decisive witness and required retained coverage: handleDefect(new Array(1), {type:"list"}) must return status400, Invalid input and empty state; repeat a valid record followed by a hole and a get/add command.
- Contract decisions / hard limits: No new duplicate-state uniqueness rule is authorized. Existing status protocol and sorting behavior stay. Full target combines validation precedence, commands and mutually independent snapshots, not a standalone every-loop.

Position-preserving catalog transactions

- Proposed change class: `reference-fix`.
- Exact current hold: Sparse malformed catalog returns success instead of invalid-state response.
- Narrow correction: Fully validate all catalog indexes before copying or dispatch. Preserve five commands, replacement ID agreement, append/replace/remove ordering and data/catalog nonaliasing.
- Decisive witness and required retained coverage: applyCatalogCommand(new Array(1), {type:"readAll"}) must return status400 and empty catalog. Repeat with a valid matching prefix plus hole and ensure malformed-state precedence.
- Contract decisions / hard limits: Do not merge this with defect-handler data or silently add duplicate-input rejection. This is a related CRUD family, so main should account for family-token composition; not a subscription template.

Recursive activity normalization

- Proposed change class: `reference-fix`.
- Exact current hold: Sparse media bypass map-based malformed-value validation.
- Narrow correction: Visit every media slot instead of map-skipping holes, including inside shared activities. Keep type validation, empty media, optional defaults, ancestor-cycle detection and explicit detached field reconstruction.
- Decisive witness and required retained coverage: Use otherwise valid activity with media:new Array(1); require TypeError. Also place the hole in shared.media, check valid deep snapshots and shared cycles.
- Contract decisions / hard limits: No recursive-depth cap or new prototype restriction. Omitted optional fields retain original normalization; no new present-undefined policy is proposed. Entire target has recursive identity/cycle and validation/copy interactions.

Async recipe storage and notification lifecycle

- Proposed change class: `reference-fix`.
- Exact current hold: Sparse ingredients bypass per-element validation and are accepted as valid record.
- Narrow correction: Fix sparse ingredient validation in add and update before commit. Fresh read also shows raw-nonempty key and ingredient strings incorrectly checked with trim; use raw string length there, while retaining explicitly trimmed-title validity and exact stored strings.
- Decisive witness and required retained coverage: add({key:"k",title:"Valid",ingredients:new Array(1)}) rejects TypeError, emits start then failure with the same error, and leaves get("k") null. Invalid update retains prior record. Accept whitespace-only nonempty key/ingredient; reject truly empty strings.
- Contract decisions / hard limits: Do not silently preserve the extra nonblank restriction. Keep notify-throw behavior and notification ordering; no rollback after a success notification failure is newly promised. Construct a one-defect sparse-validation mutant that otherwise follows the corrected string domain.

Sequential async transformation pipeline

- Proposed change class: `oracle-rebuild`.
- Exact current hold: Prompt explicitly asks for an async function. Tests require assert.throws(() => runStages(null)) synchronous validation; a true async function instead returns a rejected Promise. Reference accommodates this using an ordinary function with synchronous validation and an async inner function. Hold the incompatible async API/error contract; no runtime was needed to establish the language-level distinction.
- Narrow correction: Use an actual async exported runStages with validation before any stage invocation; malformed input rejects its returned Promise. Replace original synchronous assert.throws oracles with direct returned-Promise/no-synchronous-throw checks and rejection assertions.
- Decisive witness and required retained coverage: Calling runStages(1,[sideEffect,7]) must return a Promise without synchronously throwing; awaiting it rejects TypeError with sideEffect count0. Preserve sequential awaits, one argument, explicit undefined call receiver, exact error identity and no later stage after rejection.
- Contract decisions / hard limits: Async promise settlement is explicit, not a new contract. Do not test source spelling or constructor.name as a substitute for behavior. Use ordinary strict callbacks to inspect the supplied undefined receiver; do not demand altered native sloppy-function this binding.

Promise-settled metadata localization

- Proposed change class: `reference-fix`.
- Exact current hold: Metadata validation throws synchronously instead of settling through the required returned Promise.
- Narrow correction: Ensure loadLocalizedResource validation/localization occurs within the returned Promise semantics; localizeMeta itself stays synchronous. Preserve missing-address bypass, frozen ready/missing results and repeated/unmatched interpolation.
- Decisive witness and required retained coverage: Direct call with valid address and title:{key:" "} returns a Promise without throwing synchronously; promise rejects TypeError. Invalid language also rejects, while missing address skips invalid metadata.
- Contract decisions / hard limits: Do not require async keyword/reflection shape, new dictionary-prototype policy or I/O. Bind the explicitly promised returned-Promise behavior and retain native substitution semantics.

Ordered shipment-draft validation

- Proposed change class: `reference-fix`.
- Exact current hold: HOLD, required enumerable-own presence: The contract defines a valid draft by the three enumerable own keys, with all three present. Reference only uses Object.keys to reject unknown keys, then reads required values without verifying their enumerable-own presence. A plain object with non-enumerable priority is accepted. This is not a demand to preserve arbitrary hidden extras: their exclusion is expressly permitted and the hidden-extra test is correct. It is failure to enforce the explicitly required key set.
- Narrow correction: Require each of recipientCode/crateCount/priority to be an enumerable own key, in addition to validating its value. Preserve plain Object.prototype restriction, ignored non-enumerable extras, sorted unknown enumerable issues and deterministic field order.
- Decisive witness and required retained coverage: Define priority as a non-enumerable own valid string on an otherwise valid plain draft: result must be invalid with priority issue. Repeat each required key independently; an extra hidden key remains accepted.
- Contract decisions / hard limits: No arbitrary hidden-extra rejection, symbol policy expansion or exact unpromised issue-message text. Use behavior/field order and declared discriminated union.

Format validation before uniqueness reporting

- Proposed change class: `reference-fix`.
- Exact current hold: Duplicate email issue precedes accessLevel format issue despite required append-after-validation order.
- Narrow correction: Defer well-formed duplicate email issue until after all format/required checks, especially UPDATE accessLevel. Keep CREATE/UPDATE field sets, own-property distinction, current-ID exclusion and normalized uniqueness.
- Decisive witness and required retained coverage: UPDATE with email:"a@b.com",accessLevel:"" and existing a@b.com must report accessLevel first and append Email is already in use. Reverse account order and preserve at most one field-format issue.
- Contract decisions / hard limits: No new email grammar or whitespace normalization decision; boundary witness uses unambiguous a@b.com. Independent tests must not invent exact generic format-message wording.

Recursive style registry property fidelity

- Proposed change class: `reference-fix`.
- Exact current hold: Own __proto__ style string lost during deep clone.
- Narrow correction: Use safe own data-property insertion for all copied style keys so __proto__ remains ordinary data, on initial copy and getter copies. Preserve recursive validation, null-prototype inputs, insertion order and no input/result aliases.
- Decisive witness and required retained coverage: Null-prototype palette with enumerable own __proto__:"retain" must yield an own property with that string after getScheme; repeat nested rules and mutate results to verify isolation.
- Contract decisions / hard limits: Symbols/inherited keys remain outside model; do not mandate a specific returned prototype. Avoid dropping readable own string data when broad copy is promised; use own property names if supporting non-enumerable inputs. Do not add a cycles/stack-depth policy beyond accepted recursive style values. Main requirement: preserve every own string-keyed accepted value, including non-enumerable readable properties, using own property names; symbols/inherited properties remain excluded. No returned-prototype requirement.

Proportional grid fill plus transactional rectangle clearing

- Proposed change class: `oracle-rebuild`.
- Exact current hold: Column assignment uses round despite explicit floor formula; original test expects incorrect mapping.
- Narrow correction: Apply the explicit Math.floor(x*values.length/width) formula, not round, and correct all downstream expected matrices in independent tests. Full read also shows some-based sparse values acceptance: validate every element before changing grid.
- Decisive witness and required retained coverage: width5,height1 with ["A","B"] must be A,A,A,B,B. Check more-values-than-columns, failed fill nonmutation, rectangle defaults/bounds/zero no-op and deep snapshots.
- Contract decisions / hard limits: Keep exact floor rule, anchor API and existing rectangle validation. Do not add huge allocation probes or inferred canvas capacity limits. If using a single-defect mutant, retain valid full-element validation and only replace floor with round.

Gregorian filtering with complete validation and copies

- Proposed change class: `reference-fix`.
- Exact current hold: Valid Gregorian year 0099 rejected by Date.UTC year remapping.
